mentions.name: Automatia
mentions.description: A cozy browser-based voxel game with RPG and platforming elements. Each player gets their own private instance forked from a "master tape" world maintained by the developer; after forking, the instance is the player's own to modify however they want.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a cozy voxel game with RPG and platforming elements. Still early days, so I'm still figuring things out. Players play on their own private instances. The world is very malleable as player instances are based on a "master tape" world that I maintain. After creation that fork is the players own, and they do whatever they want.
mentions.author: fwsgonzo
